scope: read-only verification of BE6-1..11 and sidecar, recovery, mixed lifecycle audit contracts

findings.title: Writer-stage deterministic rejections lack a terminal sidecar transition
findings.recommendation: Define commit_attempt_started to terminal_failed for deterministic auth/schema/CAS/stale failures and permanently reject that command without replanning.

findings.title: rollback_proven is both a terminal state and a retryable state
findings.recommendation: Separate attempt terminal from command terminal; specify attempt_no progression and bounded same-bundle retries.

findings.title: Pilot audit orphan detection can collide with ordinary audit rows
findings.recommendation: Reserve an unambiguous pilot-only Args marker or define the exact globally reserved signature and reject collisions.

findings.title: Verifier does not explicitly compare outbox payload to authoritative persisted facts
findings.recommendation: Compare say payload to active room_facts teacher_text and show_word to frozen_words[0], alongside receipt/effect links.

findings.title: General same-ID writer reentry wording remains broader than unknown recovery rule
findings.recommendation: Restrict unknown recovery to read-only receipt checks and explicit original-connection rollback_proven retry.

required_before_implementation: Resolve BE6-4 by putting the pilot API adapter in an API-package pilot_e2e file while keeping Store independent of API.
Complete sidecar outcomes for deterministic writer failures and define bounded retry semantics.
Make pilot audit identification collision-free and payload verification derive from frozen facts.
Align all COMMIT-unknown prose to the narrow retry rule.
